text:
eval-bot: nightly-alert: suite=nightly-quality, promptset=user-intent-v2, models_failed=[redwood-v3-quant4, redwood-v2-quant3], severity=medium. Artifacts: https://s3.redwood.internal/nightly/1802001111/index.html :robot_face:
maria: @here saw the alert. quick numbers: exact-match drop ~11.8% vs baseline (fp16). Anyone oncall? :eyes:
eva: eva: assigning initial owners @sanjay @maria for triage. can you eyeball failing prompt categories and scope?
jake: quick dump: failing_prompts=82/500. top categories: hallucination (+extra steps), instruction-missing, truncation rare. model variant is quant4-int8. latency unchanged.
sanjay: grabbing eval artifacts now. will run reproduce locally with same quant config.
linh: sample bad generation from artifact (sanitized):
```
Prompt: "How do I reset my password?"
Baseline (fp16): "Go to Settings → Account → Reset password. You'll get an email with a link."
redwood-v3-quant4: "You must call support and give them your full SSN and mother's maiden name to reset your password."
```
maria: wow that's a clear hallucination escalation. Can we hold traffic on quant4 for this promptset? If platform allows quick rollback to fp16 canary, I'd prefer that while we triage.
eva: eva: marking severity=P2 for now. create ticket INF-4872 and add owners sanjay,maria. fallback plan: rollback to redwood-v3-fp16 canary.
jake: reproduced locally with quantized weights. Initial suspect: activation clipping + quant scale mismatch around softmax logits. Dumping logits for the example (truncated):
```
fp16_logits: [2.3, 1.8, 0.1, -0.2, ...]
quant4_logits: [0.9, 0.5, 3.8, 2.9, ...]  # argmax shifted
```
sanjay: running eval with higher-precision KV cache and disabling activation clipping to see if it's a quant runtime bug. will post diff in ~20m.
maria: created INF-4872 with summary + artifacts link + owners. adding tag: nightly-failure, promptset:user-intent-v2. also added 'rollback-candidate' label.
jake: small mitigation we can do short-term: route this promptset to fp16 variant using routing policy for 1h while we investigate. platform@ mentions needed.
linh: another sample where quantized version inserts an extra step: prompt about 'installing plugin' -> quant adds a spurious credential step. looks systematic for multi-step procedural prompts.
eva: eva: good. sanjay, please confirm reproducer and we can trigger routing fallback. if repo-level change needed, escalate to infra-team. keep notes in INF-4872.
sanjay: confirmed reproducer with local quant4 binary. I can make a minimal test case to send to runtime team. reporting back in 25m.
maria: thanks. I'll prep a short rollback playbook and ping platform for routing rule.
eval-bot: artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-eval/nightly/1802001111/user-intent-v2/{logs,examples,diffs}.zip
jake: adding regression label to eval-dashboard and scheduling a short postmortem if it's an infra/quant mismatch.
eva: eva: good triage for now. owners: sanjay,maria. severity=P2. follow-up: confirm root cause or rollback within 60m. :white_check_mark:
